name: Badminton Coaching
description: Coaching top players and running club sessions
extendedDescription:
Alongside competing, I coach a handful of top players individually and help run sessions at De Pluimplukkers — the biggest badminton club in Belgium. Coaching is a different challenge to playing: it's about reading someone else's game, figuring out what clicks for them, and finding the right way to communicate a correction or a tactic.

I find it genuinely rewarding to help players improve and see things come together on court. It also keeps me sharp as a player — explaining why something works forces you to understand it better yourself.
